items.summary: CFO recommendation: preserve containment and reject new spend, launches, and duplicate work. Revenue support is insufficient for ROI or contribution-margin claims: Amazon data covers only 2026-09-21, showing 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission under `other`; none is site-attributed. AI usage separately reports $1,002.46 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30, so subtracting it from $4.92 would be invalid due to period and attribution mismatch. Execute the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement only after capacity is released, with a financial stop condition: no scale decision until site-attributed orders, commission, incremental AI cost, and infrastructure allocation are available.

Attribution and cost-to-learn disposition: allthingsmasonic.com has 61 Amazon clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission for 2026-09-21; its September AI cost is $12.4675703. The observable ratio is $0.2044 AI cost per registered affiliate click, but this is not incremental experiment cost-to-learn and must not be presented as ROI. The minimum valid learning record is pre/post outbound clicks on changed pages, site-attributed orders and commission, incremental AI calls/cost, and allocated infrastructure cost over the defined 14-day or 100-relevant-impression/click window.

Budget exposure remains bounded but incomplete. The brief provides no monthly spend limit, fixed-cost budget, marketing budget, revenue target, or infrastructure billing total; therefore budget utilization, runway, full contribution margin, and payback are not calculable. Do not infer zero infrastructure cost from missing telemetry. The minimum finance source is a dated provider billing export covering AI, hosting/CDN, domains/registrars, analytics, and other recurring services, with allocation keys to site, fleet, and experiment.

items.title: Produce finance contribution-margin and attribution baseline
items.summary: Create one dated finance evidence pack using existing analytics, affiliate attribution, and AI-usage telemetry, while explicitly recording the missing infrastructure and recurring-service cost source. Reconcile revenue windows to cost windows, separate site-attributed from aggregate revenue, calculate descriptive AI cost ratios without labeling them ROI, and define the minimum billing allocation needed for contribution margin and budget exposure.
